title: Prediction-level verification data for ordinal baselines and duplicate handling in tabular learning
description: Saved binary probabilities, ordinal scores and predictions, model selection records, split and fold indices for 33 recorded runs. Includes checksum-verified reconstructed source-row lineage, duplicate-group identifiers, transformed targets, exact bin boundaries, development-selected constant baseline predictions, original environment records, and portable verification code. Upstream raw sources and fitted model weights are not redistributed. Data and documentation CC BY 4.0; software MIT; original source dataset terms remain separate.
